links.comparator_used: Pre-AI period worklist reading order without AI reprioritization (standard worklist prioritization)
links.outcome: Report turnaround time and wait time for PE-positive CTPA examinations
links.effect: Mean report turnaround time 47.6 vs 59.9 minutes (mean difference 12.3 min [95% CI 0.6-26.0]); mean wait time 21.4 vs 33.4 minutes (mean difference 12.0 min [95% CI 0.9-25.3]); read time no significant difference (26.3 vs 26.5 min). Routine-priority exams during regular hours: wait time 15.3 vs 43.7 min (mean difference 28.4 min [95% CI 2.2-64.7]); no significant difference for stat- or urgent-priority exams.
links.quote: For PE-positive examinations, the post-AI period, compared with the pre-AI period, had significantly shorter mean report turnaround time (47.6 vs 59.9 minutes; mean difference, 12.3 minutes [95% CI, 0.6-26.0 minutes]) and mean wait time (21.4 vs 33.4 minutes; mean difference, 12.0 minutes [95% CI, 0.9-25.3 minutes]) but no significant difference in mean read time (26.3 vs 26.5 minutes; mean difference, 0.2 minutes [95% CI, -2.8 to 3.2 minutes]).

design_hint: AI-driven worklist reprioritization (triage) of positive studies
